Easy Banana Oats

Serves 2
Prep time: 5 minutes
Total time: 15 minutes

Ingredients
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1 ripe banana, mashed
- 1 1/2 cups milk
* 1 tsp cinnamon
• pinch of salt

Method
1. Combine oats, milk and salt in a small pot.
2) Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring.
3. Stir in the banana and cinnamon.
